mapper.select: SELECT ranking.user_id FROM tbl_monthly_ranking ranking JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = ranking.user_id LEFT JOIN tbl_mission_certificate_title title ON title.user_id = ranking.user_id AND title.`year_month` = ranking.`year_month` WHERE ranking.`year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( title.id IS NULL OR title.status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' OR ( title.status = 'FAILED' AND title.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND title.failed_at IS NOT NULL AND title.failed_at <= #{retryNotBefore} ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_mission_certificate_title (user_id, `year_month`) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_mission_certificate_title SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', provider = #{provider}, model = #{model}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, input_hash = #{inputHash}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = NULL, failed_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND status IN ('NOT_REQUESTED', 'FAILED')

UPDATE tbl_mission_certificate_title SET title_1 = #{title1}, title_2 = #{title2}, title_3 = #{title3}, status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failed_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
